hook.say: True or false? Five geography facts that fool almost everyone. Three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Istanbul is the capital of Türkiye.
questions.say: Istanbul is the capital of Turkey.
questions.fact: The capital is Ankara, and has been since 1923.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Ankara, and has been since 1923.

questions.q: Africa is bigger than China, India and the USA combined.
questions.say: Africa is bigger than China, India and the U.S.A. combined.
questions.fact: Africa is 30 million km². Those three together are about 23 million.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Africa is thirty million square kilometers. Those three together are about twenty-three million.

questions.q: Mount Everest's summit is the farthest point from the centre of the Earth.
questions.say: Mount Everest's summit is the farthest point from the center of the Earth.
questions.fact: That is Chimborazo in Ecuador, because the Earth bulges at the equator.
questions.sayAnswer: False! That is Chimborazo in Ecuador, because the Earth bulges at the equator.

questions.q: Alaska is both the westernmost and the easternmost US state.
questions.say: Alaska is both the westernmost and the easternmost U.S. state.
questions.fact: Its Aleutian Islands cross the 180° line into the Eastern Hemisphere.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Its Aleutian Islands cross the 180 degree line into the Eastern Hemisphere.

questions.q: Australia is wider than the Moon.
questions.fact: Australia is about 4,000 km across. The Moon is 3,474 km wide.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Australia is about 4000 kilometers across. The Moon is only 3474 kilometers wide.
